title: PDF export cuts off final pages of long note
steps_to_reproduce: Exported a 40 page thesis note to PDF
expected_behavior: The exported PDF should contain all 40 pages of the note
actual_behavior: The last 6 or 7 pages are missing from the exported PDF

title: App crashes immediately on launch (iOS 15 after update)
steps_to_reproduce: Open the NoteNest app on iPhone 15
actual_behavior: The app crashes as soon as it is opened

title: search cafe notes with the accent (café) and nothing comes up but i KNOW i have 3 notes w that word. searching without accent works fine
steps_to_reproduce: searched cafe notes with the accent (café)
expected_behavior: searching for café should find notes containing café
actual_behavior: searching for café returns no results

title: Offline edits lost after reconnect
steps_to_reproduce: Observed note reverted to previous version
expected_behavior: Offline edits should be preserved and merged with server version upon reconnection
actual_behavior: Note reverted to pre-offline version, losing new text

title: Lost 2 hours of work after offline edits overwritten by older server version
steps_to_reproduce: Edited a note on a flight in airplane mode
Opened laptop later and found old version present, flight edits overwritten
expected_behavior: Offline edits should be preserved and merged when device reconnects
actual_behavior: Offline edits were lost and overwritten by older server version

title: Deleted tags still appear in autocomplete
steps_to_reproduce: Observed that deleted tags still autocomplete
expected_behavior: Deleted tags should not appear in the # autocomplete list
actual_behavior: Deleted tags 'old' and 'misc' still appear in the autocomplete list

title: Why can't I change the font size?? every other notes app lets you. 2 stars until this exists
Reminders ring twice
actual_behavior: Reminder notification rings twice, about 2 seconds apart

title: Attachment failed for 25MB PDF with generic error
steps_to_reproduce: Attempt to attach a 25MB PDF file to a note in NoteNest iOS app version 4.2.1
expected_behavior: The attachment should succeed or provide a clear error message indicating the size limit
actual_behavior: Shows 'Something went wrong' with no indication of the cause

title: Notes inside renamed folder disappear from sidebar
steps_to_reproduce: Renamed another folder with the same result
expected_behavior: Notes inside the renamed folder should remain visible in the sidebar
actual_behavior: None of the notes inside the renamed folder show in the sidebar, though they appear in search

title: Shared-note link shows Access denied to invitees without an account
steps_to_reproduce: Shared a note with my friend by email invite.
He clicks the link and gets 'Access denied'.
expected_behavior: Invitee without an account should be able to access the shared note via the link.
actual_behavior: Invitee gets 'Access denied' when opening the link.

title: PDF export drops the end of long notes
steps_to_reproduce: Export a long note (25 pages) to PDF
expected_behavior: All 25 pages appear in the exported PDF
actual_behavior: Only 19 pages appear in the exported PDF

title: Reminder notifications show up twice every time
steps_to_reproduce: Reminder notifications show up 2x every time
expected_behavior: Reminder notifications should show up once
actual_behavior: Reminder notifications show up twice every time
